A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have proposed a novel self supervised video representation model MemDPC, which can be trained with either RGB, optical flow, or RGB and optical flow, and it can achieve state of the art performance on action recognition, video retriaval, learning with scarce annotated data and unintentional action recognition.
MemDPC can learn a compact representation for action recognition, which can be used in other downstream tasks with comparable or better performance.

the proposed MemDPC architecture is a very effective framework for video representation learning.
